title: Empty --stats-out token ("") silently disables telemetry and bypasses the one-demo guard in both binaries
detail: An explicitly passed empty path token (e.g. an unset shell variable quoted as "$OUT") is accepted: stats_live becomes false, so both binaries run telemetry-off with exit 0 and no stream — violating the stated W1 intent "never silently run telemetry-off"; the exactly-one-demo guard is skipped too.
recommended_fix: Reject an empty path token as a usage error (exit 2) in both parsers: after consuming the token, error when the path string is empty.

title: App's new per-step state_hash/stats_emit path allocates into the temp allocator that the app never frees
detail: state_hash serializes the full state into the temp scratch each stepped tick (20 Hz), and the PP_DEBUG overlay's fmt_tmp strings add per-frame allocations; unlike the harness drivers (free_all per tick), the app loop never frees the temp allocator — sessions with --stats-out or the overlay grow memory without bound.
recommended_fix: Bracket the per-step hash+stats_emit block (and the overlay draw) with free_all(context.temp_allocator) per tick/frame in the app loop, mirroring the harness drivers.
